problem.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
problem.source: Official LeetCode problem page; Chinese explanation independently paraphrased
facts: Input is an ascending array possibly rotated at an unknown pivot.
The required runtime is O(log n).

claims.claim: With distinct values and one rotation pivot, at least one half split by mid remains sorted.
claims.validation: Single-descent structure of a rotated ascending array.

claims.claim: If the target is not within the value interval of the sorted half, that entire half can be discarded.
claims.validation: Monotonicity within the identified sorted half.

claims.claim: The closed candidate interval shrinks by at least half per iteration, yielding O(log n) time and O(1) space.
claims.validation: Binary-search loop and constant scalar state.
